name: Aquarium wa Odoranai: Shinitagari no Idol
original_name: アクアリウムは踊らない 死にたがりのアイドル
source:
This is the story of the twenty-four hours leading up to a death.

"I-I just don't want to suffer when I die. Is it true I can do that here?"

Hikaru, a failed idol, goes to Bianca Aquarium to have her wish to die granted.

"It is. I'll make sure that you die without pain. But if you die on your own... I will murder you."

There, she meets the mysterious Holo. A cleaner wrasse who is the self-proclaimed cutest maid in the world, Holo is imperious and pushy.

Holo has been searching for people who will allow him to perform the Dirge of the Abysmal ritual upon them because they're willing to die. However, just as he is about to perform it on Hikaru, he discovers that something has gone terribly wrong. The ring with the blue stone, which is essential to the ritual, is a fake. The real one was stolen.

Chasing down the thief brings Holo face-to-face to a strange figure with pale skin and red eyes, who says, "You've been allowed to run free too long, cleaner. Or should I say... murderer?"

Then they disappear, as if into thin air.

"Without that ring, neither your wish nor mine can be granted. We need that ring, Hikaru."

Will Hikaru's wish come true?

What is the wish that Holo is trying to make true by sacrificing so many people?

[Taken from Steam]
translation:
这是一段记录距离死亡降临前最后二十四小时的故事。

“我、我只是不想在死的时候受苦。听说在这里真的能办到，是真的吗？”

走投无路的过气偶像“光”来到碧安卡水族馆，只求实现自己一心赴死的愿望。

“是真的。我会确保你毫无痛苦地死去。但要是你敢擅自寻死……我就宰了你。”

在那里，她邂逅了神秘的霍洛。身为一条裂唇鱼、还自封为“全世界最可爱的女仆”，霍洛性格傲慢霸道、我行我素。

霍洛一直在寻找甘愿赴死的人，好在他们身上施行名为“水乐葬”的送葬仪式。然而，就在他准备对光举行仪式之际，却惊觉出了天大的差池——仪式不可或缺的那枚镶嵌着蓝宝石的戒指竟是个赝品，真品早已遭人窃走。

追捕窃贼的霍洛迎面撞上了一个肤色苍白、双眸赤红的诡异身影。对方冷冷开口道：“已经放任你逍遥太久了，清洁鱼。或者我该叫你……杀人犯？”

话音刚落，那人便如凭空蒸发般消失无踪。

“没有那枚戒指，无论是你的愿望还是我的愿望都无法实现。我们必须夺回那枚戒指，光。”

光的心愿究竟能否成真？

而霍洛不惜献祭如此多人的性命也要实现的愿望，究竟又是什么？
